mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL annualized growth exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over a 3-month period indicates strengthening demand, which boosts economic growth prospects and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST shows a sustained increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous 3 months signals supply-side weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO declines by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) shows an annualized growth rate below 2%, it signals a potential monetary policy misalignment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where FEDFUNDS is above 4% and CPIAUCSL growth is below 2%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the previous month signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts consumer confidence and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% over the previous 3 months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where RSAFS declines by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is rising and the GDP (GDPC1) is simultaneously contracting, it signals a tightening monetary policy in a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening monetary policy in a weakening economy
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where FEDFUNDS is rising and GDPC1 is contracting.
